name: anatomy_monster_impossible_shape_014

source_visual_profile.source_description: A twisted shape floating in midair; its angles don't seem to quite add up - it hurts to look at.  Is it inanimate?  Alive?  Something else?  You can't make heads or tails of it at all, but you can see through it - not as if it were transparent, but as if it isn't quite fully here.
